text.p: The recommended $PNAME integration for ThreadX is using the Percepio TraceRecorder library, which allows for both snapshots and streaming trace. The usage is documented in Using TraceRecorder v4.6 or later.
To integrate the TraceRecorder in a ThreadX project, follow the TraceRecorder integration guide at https://percepio.com/getstarted/latest/html/threadx.html/.
You find the TraceRecorder source code in the $PNAME installation directory under the ThreadX folder. You also find it on https://github.com/Percepio/TraceRecorderSource.
See TraceRecorder API for pointers to the TraceRecorder code documentation.
